name: Sandnes Open 2022
information: **English:** Welcome to Sandnes Open 2022! The competition will use almost the same format as the Sandnes competitions from previous years. The competition is free to attend for everyone - even for the competitiors. **Norsk:** Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2022! Konkurransen vil ha ca samme format som de tidligere Sandnes-konkurransene. Konkurransen er gratis for alle - også for deltakere.
